The '''Back Spiral''' designated [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] worlds located near the [[Indrexu Spiral]]. It consisted of [[Kaon]] and [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] located along the [[Tion Trade Route]] such as [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]], [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]], [[Eredenn Prime]], [[Rudrig/Legends|Rudrig]], [[Tion]], and [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].

In the [[Pre-Republic era]], [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII]] waged a [[Xer's Campaigns|campaign]] in the Back Spiral between [[25,150 BBY]] and [[25,130 BBY]], conquering many of those worlds and integrating them in [[Kingdom of Cron|Xer's Empire]].
